settings.title: From a R250 Website to a Growth Agency

settings.html:
Long before Marketing Premium Solutions, the business operated as Host Johannesburg. At 19, while studying engineering in Pretoria, our founder was introduced to websites through his uncle, who worked with small business owners. Most of them relied on Gumtree, Facebook Marketplace and word of mouth. Very few had professional websites, and even fewer understood how powerful the internet could be for winning customers. That gap was an opportunity, so after countless hours learning web design on YouTube, he built his very first website.

Like many journeys, ours started small. The first website we built was for a friend, for just R250. At the time, that felt like a major milestone.

What mattered wasn't the amount. It was proof that businesses were willing to pay for a solution that could help them grow.

Creativity was there from the start. Our founder grew up around design through his father's graphic design business, and that early exposure to branding and visual communication still shapes how we approach every project. Great marketing should not only perform well. It should look exceptional.

Prayer Adrian Makanda started building websites at 19, while studying engineering in Pretoria. Self-taught through YouTube and long nights of trial and error, he built his first site for R250 and never looked back. Growing up around his father's graphic design business gave him an eye for branding that still shapes MPS today.

What began as Host Johannesburg grew, through the COVID years, into a full digital practice and then into Marketing Premium Solutions, a growth agency built on systems rather than once-off services. Today he leads MPS and a hand-picked team of specialists, working directly with every client.

Growth should never happen by chance. It should happen by design.

settings.title: A Team of Specialists Behind Every Project

settings.editor: Marketing Premium Solutions operates with a network of specialists across web development, paid ads, SEO, content creation, photography, and drone production, each engaged when their expertise is needed. This structure lets us deliver agency-grade work at speed, without the overhead of a bloated team that gets your account passed to junior staff. When you work with us, you work directly with the founder and a team hand-picked for your project.

• Client Success Story

From Travel Agency to Full Booking Platform

One of our proudest projects began with a travel agency that first approached us for promotional design work. Over time, the relationship grew.

We eventually developed a complete online booking platform that lets travellers browse destinations, choose packages and dates, and pay securely directly on the website. It transformed how the business operates and created a smoother experience for customers and staff alike.

Today we continue to support the business through digital marketing and TikTok management. For us, this is what a great partnership looks like, growing together over time.
